subject.title: Control UI: media/config endpoints 401 over Tailscale Serve origin, breaking local media previews (works fine via loopback)

question: Should verified Tailscale Serve identity, with the Control UI browser-origin policy, be accepted for the Control UI bootstrap, avatar, and assistant-media HTTP read routes without a bearer token?
rationale: The broken path is source-reproducible, but closing the issue depends on accepting a deliberate auth-boundary expansion from WebSocket-only Tailscale identity to selected HTTP read routes.

options.title: Approve limited HTTP-read parity
options.body: Accept the open PR's dedicated http-control-ui surface for bootstrap, avatar, and assistant-media reads after confirming whois verification, browser-origin checks, and non-Control-UI HTTP APIs remain unchanged.

options.title: Keep HTTP reads token-only
options.body: Reject tokenless Tailscale HTTP reads and require the dashboard to recover these fetches through an explicit bearer, device-token, or session credential path.

options.title: Fold into broader proxy auth design
options.body: Defer this item into the broader reverse-proxy bootstrap work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12441 if maintainers want one unified browser credential model.

recommendation.title: Approve limited HTTP-read parity
recommendation.body: Accept the open PR's dedicated http-control-ui surface for bootstrap, avatar, and assistant-media reads after confirming whois verification, browser-origin checks, and non-Control-UI HTTP APIs remain unchanged.
